DML.SELECT: SELECT location_id as "id", location_type_id as "locationTypeId", lane as "lane", alias as "alias", description as "description", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM conf.locations WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.locations (location_id, location_type_id, alias, lane, description, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:id=getNextId{'conf.locations'$'location_id'}, :locationTypeId, :alias, :lane, :description, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
